summary: Frontend-only smoke/regression verification of the date-fns 4.1.0 -> ^3.6.0 downgrade. Verified installed tree: node_modules/date-fns = 3.6.0, yarn.lock resolves date-fns@^3.6.0 -> 3.6.0, react-day-picker still 8.10.1. Runtime: login with demo@masterai.com/demo1234 via [email-input]/[password-input]/[submit-auth-button] redirects to /app/typing with no blank screen. Typing engine regression PASSED: extracted 198-char passage, click [type-over-engine] focuses [type-input], live [live-wpm] updated mid-run (98 wpm, 100% acc, 0/198 counter working), typing to completion rendered [result-card] (824 wpm / 100% / 3s) + [restart-button] and a '+102 XP / Streak 3 days' toast. Navigated all 8 requested routes (/app, /app/learn, /app/ask, /app/test, /app/word, /app/profile, /app/leaderboard, /app/subscription) — every page rendered non-empty content (textLen 300-1081) with ZERO new console errors and no pageerror. NO console errors mentioning date-fns, react-day-picker, Calendar, 'Module not found' or 'Cannot find module' anywhere. Only console noise observed: two 401 responses on the /login page before authentication (expected — unauthenticated /api/auth/me probe).
critical_code_review_comments: Login page fires an unauthenticated auth-me request that logs two 401s to the console before login; consider skipping the probe when no masterai_token exists to keep the console clean.

date-fns 3.6.0 is API-compatible with react-day-picker 8.10.1; if the project later upgrades to react-day-picker v9 remember to move date-fns back to v4 in the same commit to avoid a new ERESOLVE conflict.

src/components/ui/calendar.jsx is currently not mounted by any tested route, so the date-fns path is only validated at bundle/module-resolution level (build + no runtime module errors), not through an actual rendered Calendar interaction.
seed_data_creation: Reset db.usage.updateMany({},{$set:{course:0,ask:0,quiz:0,document:0}}) before the run to clear demo-user AI quotas.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login testids are [email-input], [password-input], [submit-auth-button] (NOT login-email/login-password). Typing flow: read passage via last inner div innerText of [type-over-engine], click [type-over-engine] (focuses [type-input]), then page.keyboard.type(text, delay=6); on completion [live-wpm] is replaced by [result-card]+[restart-button]. Sidebar nav testids render twice (desktop aside + mobile Sheet) — scope accordingly. date-fns downgrade verified clean; no regression.
rca_of_the_issue: No issues found. date-fns 3.6.0 satisfies react-day-picker@8.10.1's peer range (^2.28.0 || ^3.0.0), and no application code imports date-fns v4-only APIs, so the downgrade is runtime-neutral.
